description: 12 multi-feature / underspecified prompts for the vague-request rubric (issue 385).

prompts.title: Ambiguous delete
expectedSubFeatures: list or confirm target items before deleting

prompts.title: Shop with ores and food
prompts.prompt: In pack bench, build a /shop menu with ores and food categories where players can buy items.

prompts.title: Starter and daily kit menu
prompts.prompt: In pack bench, create a /kits menu with a one-time Starter kit and a 24h Daily kit that shows cooldown feedback.

prompts.title: Zombie hunter quest
prompts.prompt: In pack bench, build a Zombie Hunter quest with a /quests progress GUI and a rare rotten heart item drop.

prompts.title: Mystery crate with key
prompts.prompt: In pack bench, create a placed mystery crate block/furniture with a matching crate key item and weighted prizes.

prompts.title: Ruby sword forge
prompts.prompt: In pack bench, create a /forge GUI that upgrades sample:ruby_sword using 3 sample:ruby and 200 coins.

prompts.title: Lifesteal dash sword (partial gap)
prompts.prompt: In pack bench, make an RPG lifesteal dash sword with a 5s right-click dash and lifesteal on hit.

prompts.title: /pay and /top leaderboard (partial gap)
prompts.prompt: In pack bench, add a /pay command and a /top richest or top kills menu.

prompts.title: Mana bar HUD + fireball wand (partial gap)
prompts.prompt: In pack bench, show a mana bar HUD that regenerates every second and powers a fireball wand.
